Md. A. Aziz alias Abdul Aziz ----- Petitioner
Vs.

full_judgment: 9. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing on behalf of the leave-petitioner, submits that the High Court Division failed to consider that the prosecution could not prove the charge levelled against the petitioner beyond reasonable doubt and as such, the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division affirming the judgments of the Courts below should be set aside.
